repos_data.description: Zsh plugin that converts ..., ...., ....., etc., into cd commands to navigate parent directories.
A plugin to search history in a specific directory
Per directory history for zsh, as well as global history, and the ability to toggle between them with ^G.
Giving you a history which is sensitive to the directory you are currently in
zsh plugin that offers a simple way to navigate up through directories

repo_meta_data.description: cdh is a smart shell function to manage and navigate your directory history with fuzzy search. In another words, it tracks directories you visit and store as a index for fast navigation between your most used directories.
